scope: Only error-spike SQL and its existing source-only test file were modified by this agent.
No product tracing, threshold, sample-weight, history/warmup, source-anomaly, deployment, model, resource or PostHog configuration mutation.

merge_risk.evidence: Continuous workflow and after-job entries can be non-root; same-trace success was insufficiently scoped. Two original SQL regressions failed before the change. Installed queue SDK and one existing trace prove the finite vqs.process intermediary.
merge_risk.rollback: Revert only the error-spike query and paired description. Missing or unrecognized graph proof remains counted, so unsupported topology adds noise rather than suppressing unknown failures.

semantic_contract.wake: HTTP404 not-found / world.hooks.getByToken / hook.resume must belong to its exact successful after:workflow-wake ancestor, including non-root entries.
semantic_contract.cron: HTTP404 chain must belong to its exact cron:reconcile span and successful matching GET /api/cron/reconcile parent.
semantic_contract.flow: Closed HTTP409/410 event-create chains require their own successful workflow.execute and exact successful 2xx flow delivery. Proof is direct same-trace invocation parent, one vqs.process parent hop, or the unique valid invocation link to those exact delivery contexts. No arbitrary recursive ancestry or trace-wide success.
semantic_contract.links: posthog.trace_spans.links is Array(String); each JSON link uses trace_id/span_id in native table base64 encoding. Links on vqs.process are not used as proof of its delivery.
fail_closed: missing/ambiguous/malformed/unmatched link without exact local parent proof
semantic_contract.preserved_optimization: Owner live query narrow workflow_spans scan and one handled_attempts role expansion are retained.

verification.same_hour_result_comparison: Earlier draft and final queries ran at different times; their output difference is not treated as a controlled measurement of only the SQL change.

source_evidence.workflow_core: Installed @workflow/core 5.2.3 telemetry.js 67-71,361-366; runtime.js 596-629,752,1935,4474-4505; runtime/step-executor.js 117-118,190,432,498,743; runtime/suspension-handler.js wait_created; resume-hook.js hook.resume/getByToken.
source_evidence.queue: Installed @workflow/world-vercel 5.2.3 queue.js 461,643; @vercel/queue 0.8.0 dist/index.mjs 417,1605,1715,2649. Normal vqs.process status is unset(0), failure is 2.
source_evidence.sanitizer: lib/tracing/sanitize.ts preserves link contexts and strips workflow./step. display suffixes; it does not export trace.mode. Topology, not that attribute, is used.
source_evidence.actual_historical_topology: evidence/workflow-queue-topology-readonly/receipt.json; one fixed known trace has flow(status1,2xx) -> vqs.process(status0) -> workflow.execute(status1), with execute link to a different origin. This does not identify historical installed SDK version or prove future telemetry completeness.

remaining_boundaries: Historical readonly query success is not production acceptance of #1512; insight application and deployed-run proof are still owned by root.
Finite graph matching intentionally retains errors when required ancestors/links are missing, dropped, outside the source window or use an unrecognized SDK topology.
Normal invocation return is not treated as business success without exact successful delivery proof; typed errors still remain counted.
Query durations include MCP transport and formatting; no ClickHouse engine-cost or latency SLA is inferred.
